# Font Size

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Font Size

The font-size property is used to change the size of the font.

```html
1<p>Web development is fun!</p>
2
3<ul>
4     <li>HTML for structure.</li>
5     <li>CSS for styling.</li>
6     <li>JavaScript for interactivity.</li>
7</ul>
```

```css
1p {
2    font-size: 24px;
3}
4
5ul {
6    font-size: 18px;
7}
```

The default font size for both paragraphs and lists is 16 pixels in most browsers.

The above code sets the paragraph font size to 24 pixels and the list font size to 18 pixels.
